sample.question:
The synchronized front, right, and top panels show labeled beacons in a 4x4x4 coordinate cube. Coordinates are (x,y,z), each from 0 to 3. Rotation Z+ maps (x,y,z) to (3-y,x,z); rotation X+ maps it to (x,3-z,y).
Which beacon has the greatest z-coordinate?
A. D
B. A
C. B
D. C
sample.analysis: Read height from the three views. Beacon D is at (3, 1, 3) and has z=3, greater than every other beacon. The answer is A.
